notes.title: [Ver1.02] April 26 Update Announcement [Dodge Dash / Clear Time Features]
notes.content:
Thank you for playing 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.

Based on feedback from users who have played so far, we have implemented an update at 3:00 PM on Saturday, April 26 (JST), to provide a better experience for both existing and new players. Please see the details below. Note: Some spoilers may be included.

🦊----------------------------------------------------🦊

🌽Major Updates🌽

[u]・Added "Dodge Dash" feature (can be enabled from the menu)[/u]
　- When enabled, the dash becomes invincible during its duration.
　- A red effect appears during the dodge dash, and a special effect is triggered when dodging through an attack.
As this affects gameplay systems, it must be enabled manually from the menu. We hope this makes the gameplay even more exhilarating!

[u]・Added rough difficulty display to stage selection.[/u]

[u]・Added time tracking features for time attack players.[/u]
　- Clear time is now shown for each stage (results screen and stage selection).
　- Timer now supports centiSeconds format.
　- Best times and total time are shown at the ending.
We hope this helps players aiming for speedruns and RTA!

🌽Detailed Changes🌽

[u]・Player controls:[/u]
　- Pressing "Jump + Attack" while on the ground now triggers a "Spin Slash."
　- Increased damage of the triple slash combo.
　- Increased the damage radius of charged shots.

[u]・Gameplay systems:[/u]
　- Shortened logo display on second and subsequent game launches.
　- Fixed a mismatch in the description and actual required "Super Chats" for extra lives (7→6).
　- Fixed an issue where tea leaves would sometimes decrease when returning to stage select.
　- Ending staff credits can now be fast-forwarded by holding a button.
　- Clear time and best time are now shown in the post-clear mini-game.
　- Slightly adjusted item prices in the shop.
　- Important items like "Super Tea" now have enhanced color highlights.
　- Fixed performance drop that could occur after defeating a boss.

[u]・"Oeyama Temple Ruins" stage:[/u]
　- Reduced the HP of the boss’s clones.
　- Fixed an issue where small Fubuzilla lacked corruption effect.

[u]・"Frozen Theme Park" stage:[/u]
　- Greatly reduced the hitbox of the mid-boss’s spear.

[u]・"Underground Ruins" stage:[/u]
　- Added a helpful mechanic at the location where 【け】 is obtained.
　- Placed guiding tea leaves in unclear areas of the wire mesh zone.
　- Added a platform in the fall safety zone to make it less punishing.
　- Added telegraph lines for the final boss's punch attack and adjusted height so it can be dodged with a ground dash.
　- Adjusted the number of cannon shots and slightly reduced damage.
　- Slightly reduced hitboxes for several of the final boss's attacks.
　- Fixed a bug where some bullets from the hidden boss were not spawning.

・Minor bug fixes

🦊----------------------------------------------------🦊
By setting BGM to 0, you can play while enjoying your favorite music!
How about trying it out with Fubuki-san's songs or a variety of other styles?

We hope you continue to enjoy 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.

notes.title: [10,000 Copies Sold / Upcoming Update Plans] April 18 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for playing 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.

This post will cover the following 📝

・Thanks for reaching 10,000 copies sold
・Upcoming update plans
・Details of the current update

🌽10,000 Copies Sold!🌽
Since its release on April 13 (JST), the game has surpassed 10,000 copies sold! 🎉
We sincerely thank you all for your warm support.

🦊----------------------------------------------------🦊

🌽Upcoming Update Plans🌽
This title is not designed to rapidly progress through many stages, but rather to offer a challenging and satisfying action experience tailored to each player’s skill level.

To enhance replayability, we plan to introduce the following new modes:

・"NG+" Mode
　Carry over your items and experience a new type of gameplay.

・"EXTRA" Mode
　A completely new experience including revamped stage layouts and more.

We kindly ask for your patience as we work on these updates.

🦊----------------------------------------------------🦊

🌽Update Details🌽
To provide a better gameplay experience for both current and future players, we released an update on Saturday, April 19 at 1:00 PM.

Details below (may contain some spoilers):

・Adjusted mid-boss difficulty in select stages.
　(Cyber Akihabara, Oeyama Temple Ruins, Frozen Theme Park)
　- Also revised certain high-damage attacks.

・Adjusted the “Underground Ruins” stage:
　- Tweaked lasers and wire mesh obstacles.
　- Added hidden areas.
　　- Once per sortie, large amounts of extra lives and Tea leaves can be obtained.

・Adjusted item prices in the shop.

・Final boss adjustments:
　- Healing items now appear once a certain progress threshold is reached.
　- Reduced hitbox size of boss projectiles.

・General action adjustments/fixes:
　- Increased range of spin slash.
　- Corrected description for “Friends”.
　- Adjusted behavior of “Chin-Anago” to spawn closer.
　- Increased damage for “Maguchi” and “Fubuzilla”.

・"Boss Rush" mode is now unlocked per save data.

・Minor bug fixes

🦊----------------------------------------------------🦊

We hope you continue to enjoy 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.

notes.title: [Gameplay Guide] Try Out Different Weapons
notes.content:
Thank you for playing 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.

This is an action game built around the themes of exhilaration and challenging gameplay!
Due to the abundance of information from the very beginning, those less confident with action games may find even "Easy" mode a bit challenging.
(Normal is for those who find Easy too easy, and higher levels are for those seeking high-difficulty action!)

With that in mind, here are some recommended controls and weapons from the developers. We hope you find them helpful!

([u]We strongly recommend playing with a controller for the best gameplay experience. We also suggest setting up your controller buttons via the “Controller Settings” when selecting your save file for the first time.[/u])

🦊----------------------------------------------------------------------------------🦊

★ Charge Shot
Hold the attack button and then release to unleash a charge shot that fires a slash forward.
It can mow down multiple enemies in a single blow and erase incoming enemy projectiles all at once.
You can aim in different directions (up, down, left, right) depending on your directional input when releasing the shot.
If you haven’t been using Charge Shots, give it a try! You’ll really feel the thrill of wiping out enemies.

★ Summon
The “Oruyanke” you get at the start of the stage can be summoned with the summon button, becoming a powerful projectile weapon.
It can’t be spammed, but it can be re-summoned after a short cooldown—feel free to use it against bosses, large enemies, and even regular mobs!
You’ll also meet other summonable characters on your journey. (Hold the summon button to switch them.)
[b]Try talking to Mio at the base—she may lend you her strength.[/b]

(Small Spoiler Alert!)
★ Sub-Weapons
Sub-weapons become available after clearing the prologue and offer a more agile alternative to summons.
The first one you get, Captain Marine's Gun, is especially easy to use.
Even just using it alongside your charge shots and summons adds significant firepower.
Be sure to try it out as well!

🦊----------------------------------------------------------------------------------🦊

Master the Charge Shot, Summon, and Sub-Weapons to blast through countless enemies!
We hope every player can fully enjoy the exhilarating action this game has to offer.

Thank you for continuing to support 『FUBUKI ～zero in on Holoearth～ HOLOLIVE ALTERNATIVE』.
